intent: Retain and project existing command-output evidence; not an iOS product fix, explanation of Transport closed, new execution path, retry or acceptance relaxation.

companionWorkflow.author: forge_gap_audit
companionWorkflow.scope: Separately reviewed capture/upload changes only; not authored by this reporter contribution.

retainedSource.wrapperStreams: Fixed top-level files are read as raw bytes. The reporter does not prove the wrapper command executed, the file was freshly produced, or its producer stopped writing.
retainedSource.nestedRecords: Existing fixed-flow report.xml and a unique commands.json within that flow's bounded directory are inspected. The runner's existing text logs remain UTF-8 decoded and capped by its unchanged spawnSync maxBuffer.
retainedSource.completeRead: Requires bounded EOF, matching regular-file identity/size/mtime/ctime observations and successful descriptor close. This remains sampled, not atomic or a proof of command provenance.
retainedSource.partialRead: bytesRead may include one over-limit probe; hashedBytes binds the exact hashed prefix/read sequence. A partial input is not parsed as a complete JSON/XML document.
retainedSource.unknowns: Missing, denied, symlink, nonregular, changing, ambiguous, unconfirmed-close and over-budget cases remain explicit; no unavailable fact becomes a passing result.

projection.flowSlotsAndAttemptNumbers: Configured evidence locations; not observations of execution or recovery counts.
projection.junitCounts: Supported structural XML observations; never an acceptance pass/failure verdict.
projection.commandSelection: First failed record within bounded top-level array order; no unobserved tail or chronological inference.

retention.summaryWrite: Exclusive fixed phase-summary.json; no overwrite or replacement on duplicate.
retention.hash: Actual successful closed-file readback must match the intended bytes before the retained summary hash is reported.
retention.console: Complete marker-inclusive envelope <=8192 bytes; oversized summaries use valid fixed fallback metadata with explicit row omissions.
retention.errorIsolation: Read/write/close/hash/readback/console failures are secondary to the unchanged wrapper result. The reporter does not set process.exitCode or execute commands.

checks.evaluatedInThisEnvironment: V8 with explicit Node API compatibility shims and mocked IO

groups: iOS reporter validates CLI facts without inferring launch, workflow status or signal
closed raw byte reads preserve exact-limit EOF and a known independent SHA
over-limit, changed, denied, symlink and close-failed inputs never claim a complete hash
command projection keeps fixed assertion facts, unknowns, limits and private text separation
JUnit projection counts structure while ignoring names/messages/CDATA and refusing malformed input
fixed flow discovery refuses duplicate, symlink, depth-limited and entry-limited command inputs
exclusive summaries hash actual readback and reporter errors cannot alter the supplied result
complete console envelopes obey the byte budget and oversized summaries stay valid with omissions
result.scope: The same eight authored Node unit-test designs evaluated under POSIX and Windows-separator path models in V8, with explicit Buffer/crypto/path/assert shims and mocked file IO. These are environment variants, not sixteen independent designs; no Node process, real filesystem, actual Windows/macOS, shell, XCTest, native UI, simulator or iOS execution.

independentReview.scope: Fresh identities/readback, exact test-only path normalization, IO/hash/status/privacy/unknown/budget/error review and reproduction of the same eight designs under both separator models.

checks.sourceParse: Full reporter and test bodies passed V8 parse-only checks after imports/import.meta were neutralized; this is not a Node module execution.

rootReview.scope: Full source, exact hashedBytes correction, mock-only separator normalization, and reproduction of the same eight designs in both models; no Node/OS execution claim.

reviewCorrections.reason: Explicit hashedBytes removes ambiguity between an over-limit probe and the hashed prefix. No read-budget or command change.
Six fixture-only normalization spans make mock paths consistent under default POSIX and Windows separators; production reporter unchanged by this correction.

primaryContract.scope: Documents captured-output encoding and maxBuffer termination/truncation; no runtime version/behavior is inferred from a documentation read.

limitations: Static flow/attempt slots do not establish that any flow ran or that a recovery happened.
JUnit structural counts and top-level command-array metadata do not replace the existing strict acceptance checks.
A failed record selected from a bounded prefix is not a claim about the uninspected tail or the chronological last failure.
No raw path, arbitrary argument, entered text, test name, error message or native signal inference is emitted by the typed reporter.
Full raw top-level streams remain the companion workflow's capture responsibility; these source checks do not prove successful runtime capture.
The same eight designs run under two path models are not sixteen independent designs and are not actual Windows/macOS/Node/iOS tests.
Original iOS log retrieval failures and the earlier native touch failure remain undiagnosed.
